div.span: Persistence Layer (MongoDB Database via Mongoose ODM)

Users Collection
- email, passwordHash, role, wishlist[]

Movies Collection
- title, genre, rating, duration, isFeatured

Screens Collection
- cinemaId, rows, cols (Model scaffold)

Showtimes Collection
- movie, cinema, startTime, embedded seats[]

Bookings Collection
- ref, user, movie, showtime, seats[], status

JWT Auth Middleware
(Token verification, req.user payload)

React View Pages
Home, Movies, MovieDetail, SeatSelection, Dashboard, Admin

Vite Dev Server (Port 5173)
HMR & ESBuild Pipeline
